methodologyNotes: LAIR throughput points are batchedTok/s medians from committed reports; A/B milestones plot the new arm and record the pre-item baseline arm in tables.
Cross-host-session comparisons on this box are directional reference only (documented +/-10-35% inter-process noise); same-session alternating medians carry the signal.
The substage-profiling point is a profiled run; its own report shows throughput lands inside the unprofiled band of the prior milestone.
llama.cpp bands are carried from the dense-cpu-traversal rerun for all later milestones because later sessions did not re-run llama-bench on this box.
